items.title: Ethereum treasury firm BTCS sold ether at a loss to keep $64 million Aave loan healthy
items.summary: The Nasdaq-listed company has 46,676 ETH backing its borrowings, and the loan could become eligible for liquidation if ether slides to around $1,700.

items.title: Bitcoin firm Nakamoto owes Kraken $165 million, more than its entire market value
items.summary: About 70% of the bitcoin treasury firm’s coins are pledged to the exchange, bought at roughly $118,000 each, and bitcoin now trades under $69,000.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs are now down over $1.5 billion in net outflows for the year
items.summary: Recent rapid redemptions explain the market swoon. Bitcoin's spot price fell below $70,000 on Friday, the lowest since August.

items.title: SpaceX-Tesla merger talks put 30,000 bitcoin back in focus
items.summary: A deal could be announced as soon as December, putting $2.1 billion of bitcoin under one roof, a sliver of what the combined group would be worth.

items.title: Bitcoin dips below $70,000 as Dollar Index hits 19-month high
items.summary: The crypto market selloff gathered pace early Friday. Bitcoin dropped below $70,000 and ether traded below $2,000, triggering large liquidations in futures market.

items.title: North Korea's Binance hack faces U.S. crackdown as DOJ targets $1.2 billion in stolen crypto
items.summary: Federal authorities say they've taken infrastructure used in the FaceStealer scheme used to steal as much as $400 million in crypto assets.

items.title: U.S. President Trump names CFTC, SEC nominees for first time in a year
items.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump has named two potential commissioners each to the Securities and Exchange Commission and Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

items.title: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr.’s advisory contract over 1789 Capital’s Polymarket investment
items.summary: Trump Jr. joined Kalshi as a strategic adviser in January 2025, helping the prediction market expand its customer base and strengthen its market presence.

items.title: Illinois crypto tax is impossible to enforce as written, crypto industry tells court
items.summary: The legal battle to head off the crypto transaction tax in Illinois has drawn up a hefty roster of industry opposition, and they're saying the tax won't work.

items.title: DTCC adds Solana to Wall Street tokenization plans, targeting 2027 rollout
items.summary: The securities infrastructure giant plans to bring tokenized stocks, ETFs and U.S. Treasuries to Solana as it expands next year's roadmap beyond Stellar and Arc.

items.title: Unocoin keeps deposits and withdrawals halted over suspect transfers
items.summary: Unocoin said the transfers were signed outside BitGo’s platform while its account was frozen, possibly via a wallet recovery feature.

items.title: Bitcoin returns to 200-week trend line as analyst sees risk of $57.7K next
items.summary: Bitcoin price action interacted with its 200-week simple moving average for the first time since mid-August as it fell below $68,000.

items.title: DOJ moves to seize $1.2B from Binance hack, disrupts FaceStealer scam
items.summary: Authorities froze over $2.7 billion in Binance hack proceeds, while the separate FaceStealer scam stole over $400 million in 18 months.

items.title: Jane Street boosts Fidelity Bitcoin ETF holdings nearly 8x, trims IBIT
items.summary: Jane Street ended Q3 with 19% fewer shares in BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF, and a higher share price lifted the stake’s value to $957 million.

items.title: Microsoft 365 outage hits Outlook email and Teams calendars worldwide
items.summary: Microsoft began a wider patch rollout Friday as the outage disrupted government email and Microsoft 365 connectors in ChatGPT and Claude.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Bitcoin slides below $70K amid thin liquidity, ETF outflows
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below $70,000 as crypto sentiment hit its lowest level in more than four months, with analysts warning of institutional outflows, thinning liquidity and elevated leverage.

items.title: Trump nominates Hester Peirce successor among SEC, CFTC picks
items.summary: The White House also named a former CFTC commissioner and two CLARITY Act veterans as nominees to fill vacancies at the SEC and CFTC.

items.title: Former Nvidia CEO Huang had third alleged affair: Reuters
items.summary: Reuters reported that Jensen Huang had a relationship with another Nvidia employee, hours after he resigned as CEO.

items.title: Gemini’s quarterly retail trading volume sinks to 3-year low
items.summary: Gemini’s third-quarter trading rebound masked a deepening retail slump.

items.title: Bitcoin Drops to $69K On 'Concentrated Liquidation' and 'Weakening' Demand
items.summary: BTC dropped 5% on Friday, falling below $69,000. Experts say it was triggered by a "concentrated liquidation" and "weakening" demand.

items.title: Congress Summons Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, Lutnick Over Chip Exports to China
items.summary: House panels requested December interviews with Huang and Nvidia's top lawyer as scrutiny shifts to Commerce's oversight of chip exports.

items.title: Republican Senator Wants to Freeze AI Data Center Boom as Congress Pushes to Expand It
items.summary: Senator Josh Hawley wants a nationwide construction pause until households are protected from rising power bills, even as Congress advances legislation designed to accelerate America's already massive AI infrastructure b

items.title: North Korea Stole $400 Million in Crypto Using Deepfake Video Calls, DOJ Says
items.summary: The FBI says the “FaceStealer” scheme uses prerecorded footage and AI deepfakes of trusted contacts to trick crypto workers into installing malware on video calls—as the DOJ also moves to seize $1.2 billion from the Bina

items.title: Strategy Made $19.5 Billion in Profit. So Why Is MSCI Removing It From Stock Indexes?
items.summary: Michael Saylor’s Bitcoin giant is being excluded from major investment benchmarks, raising questions about what qualifies as a business—and whether the decision could slow its Bitcoin buying.

items.title: Why the Path to Quantum Resistance Runs Uphill for Bitcoin Wallet Makers
items.summary: Trezor CTO Tomáš Sušánka explains the trade-offs of Bitcoin’s leading post-quantum signature scheme.

items.title: Who Is Colette Kress, Jensen Huang’s Successor as Nvidia CEO?
items.summary: Nvidia’s longtime finance chief inherits its first leadership transition in 33 years, bringing decades of technology experience and Wall Street credibility to a company facing a very public leadership test.

items.title: Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom: The AI Stock Winners and Losers After Jensen Huang’s Ousting
items.summary: Nvidia shares tumbled after Jensen Huang’s exit, while AMD and Broadcom climbed and Nvidia-backed CoreWeave sank. Here's how the AI trade is shaping up.

items.title: Illinois Crypto Tax Draws Unlikely Alliance of DOJ, Banks and DeFi
items.summary: The DOJ, the U.S. Chamber of Commerce, SIFMA and a crypto coalition led by a16z, Paradigm and Uniswap filed briefs backing a lawsuit to strike down the state’s 0.2% levy on digital asset transactions.

items.title: 'A Massive Mistake': Tech, AI and Crypto Founders React to Jensen Huang’s Nvidia Exit
items.summary: Nvidia’s founder is out, and tech and crypto leaders are fuming. Some fear for open-source AI, others question the board, while Elon Musk says he’d be honored to hire Huang.
